title: A lens over live DOM
blurb: Fifteen lenses over ordinary markup: a flat magnifier, a ray-traced glass lens, fisheye, water drop, x-ray, black hole, a fiery eye and more. Each one is one magnified draw and one shader, so text stays sharp and you can click and type through the lens.
question: Can live DOM be magnified and distorted without blur while clicks and typing pass through the lens?
